title: Smart-seq2 Single-Cell RNA-Seq Modified Method
author: John J. Trombetta
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.pbgdijw
materials: Wait 5 minutes at room temperature. 00:05:00, Wait

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer and Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare a mild hypotonic lysis buffer containing 0.2% Triton X-100 and 2 U/μL RNase-Inhibitor.

substeps.instruction: Distribute 4 μL of buffer into each well of a skirted-side 96-well PCR plate.
Distribute 350 μL of buffer into a 1.5 mL RNase-free centrifuge tube.
Seal the plate with Microseal F and store at room temperature.

steps.title: Perform Single-Cell Sorting
steps.instruction: Sort cells into the prepared lysis buffer using a FACS machine.

substeps.instruction: Sort a single cell into each well of the 96-well plate.
Sort ≥10,000 cells into the 1.5 mL centrifuge tube as a population control.
Recommendation: Sort based on positive viability indicator (e.g., Calcein AM) and absence of cell death marker (e.g., EthD-1).

steps.title: Seal and Freeze Samples
steps.instruction: Secure and preserve the sorted cells.

substeps.instruction: Seal the plate with Microseal F.
Centrifuge at 800g for 1 min.
Immediately freeze the plate and population control on dry ice and store at −80°C.

steps.title: Prepare for RNA Processing
steps.instruction: Prepare the workspace and reagents for RNA handling.

substeps.instruction: Bring RNA-SPRI beads (Agencourt RNAClean XP) to room temperature for 30 minutes.
Clean the workbench and all equipment with RNAseZap.

steps.title: Perform Reverse Transcription
steps.instruction: Synthesize first-strand cDNA from the lysates.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 μL of 10 μM anchored oligo-dT RT primer and 1 μL of 10 mM dNTP mix to each lysate well.
Seal plate with Microseal B and centrifuge at 800g for 1 min.
Incubate for 3 minutes at 72 °C, then immediately place on ice.
Centrifuge plate at 800g for 1 min and unseal.

Add the following mastermix to each well: 2 μL SuperScriptII first strand buffer, 0.25 μL 100 mM DTT, 2 μL 5M betaine, 0.9 μL 100 mM MgCl2, 1 μL 10 μM template switching oligonucleotide, 0.1 μL H2O, 0.25 μL 40 U/μL RNase-Inhibitor, and 0.5 μL 200 U/μL SuperScriptII RT.
Mix by pipetting, seal, and centrifuge at 800g for 1 min.
Carry out the RT reaction in a thermal cycler.

steps.title: Amplify cDNA
steps.instruction: Perform PCR amplification of the cDNA.

substeps.instruction: Add a mastermix consisting of 13 μL KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix and 1 μL 10 μM IS PCR primer.
Carry out amplification in a thermal cycler.
Optional: Store product at 4°C overnight.

steps.title: Purify PCR Product
steps.instruction: Clean the amplified DNA using DNA SPRI beads (Agencourt AMPure XP).

substeps.instruction: Bring DNA SPRI beads to room temperature.
Centrifuge WTA plate at 800g for 1 min and unseal.
Add 0.8 volumes of DNA SPRI beads to each well and mix by pipetting.
Cover with a pipette tip box lid and incubate for 5 min on bench.
Place plate on a 96-well plate magnet and incubate for 5 min.
Perform three consecutive washes: add 100 μL 80% ethanol to each well, shift the plate on the magnet for 30 sec to move beads, and aspirate.
Aspirate final ethanol wash and dry beads at room temperature for 10 min (keep lid slightly ajar).
Remove plate from magnet and elute DNA by resuspending beads in 20 μL TE buffer.
Transfer eluent to a new 96-well plate (can be stored at 4°C overnight or −20°C).

steps.title: Quality Control and Dilution
steps.instruction: Assess the purified PCR product and prepare for library construction.

substeps.instruction: Use 1 μL of product to measure fragment size distribution via Agilent HS DNA BioAnalyzer.
Use 1 μL of product to estimate library concentration via Qubit® dsDNA HS Assay kit.
Use 1 μL of product to measure single-cell viability via Taqman qPCR (targeting housekeeping genes like ACTB and B2M).
Dilute purified PCR product to a concentration of 0.1 to 0.2 ng/μL using TE buffer.

steps.title: Prepare Dual-Index Primers
steps.instruction: Prepare the combined index primer plate for Nextera XT construction.

substeps.instruction: Thaw index primers, vortex briefly, and centrifuge.
Arrange i7 primers (orange caps, N701-N712) horizontally and i5 primers (S501-S508) vertically in the TruSeq Index Plate Fixture.
Distribute 10 μL of each index into the corresponding row/column using a multichannel pipette.
Seal, vortex mildly, and centrifuge at 800g for 1 min.
In a new 96-well plate, add 2.5 μL TD Buffer, 1.25 μL ATM, and 1.25 μL diluted PCR product to each well.
Mix by pipetting, seal, and centrifuge at 800g for 1 min.
Tagment: Incubate at 55°C for 10 min, then cool/hold at 10°C.
Unseal and immediately add 1.25 μL NT Buffer to each well and mix by pipetting.
Add 3.75 μL NPM and 2.5 μL combined Index primer solution to each well.
Mix by pipetting, seal, and centrifuge at 800g for 1 min.
Carry out amplification in a thermal cycler (product can be stored at 4°C overnight).

steps.title: Final Library Purification
steps.instruction: Perform final cleanup of the pooled libraries using DNA SPRI beads (Agencourt AMPure XP).

substeps.instruction: Bring DNA SPRI beads to room temperature.
Spin down plate at 800g for 1 min, unseal, and pool 2.5 μL from each well into a single 1.5 mL tube.
Add 0.9 volumes of SPRI beads to the pool and mix by pipetting.
Incubate for 5 min on bench, then incubate on a Dynamag ™-2 magnet for 5 min.
Perform two washes: add 500 μL 80% ethanol, rotate tube on magnet to move beads, and aspirate.
Dry beads at room temperature for 10 min while keeping the tube covered.
Remove tube from magnet and elute DNA using 30 μL TE buffer.
Transfer eluent to a new 1.5 mL tube and repeat 0.9X SPRI bead cleanup once.
Use 1 μL of the final purified product to measure fragment size (BioAnalyzer) and concentration (Qubit).
